articles.summary: AST SpaceMobile launched the first of its next-generation satellites to low Earth orbit on December 23, 2025 at 10:25 p.m. EST. The mission, called BlueBird 6, lifted off from the Satish Dhawan Space Center aboard an LVM3 rocket. articles.summary: In 2025, AST SpaceMobile launched the first of its next-generation satellites, BlueBird 6. In addition, this year saw strengthened global partnerships, expanded U.S. manufacturing, and the building of a robust spectrum portfolio to support rapid growth ahead.
